symbols.name: ConditionalOnPlugin

symbols.name: EnhancementContext

symbols.name: EnhancementProcessor

symbols.name: FriendlyName
symbols.summary: The name under which the runtime registers the plugin, used wherever a plugin is addressed by name, such as `/versatia reload <name>`.

symbols.name: LifecycleEvent
symbols.summary: A moment in a plugin's life at which the runtime walks its descriptor.

symbols.name: Phase
symbols.summary: When an enhancement is executed.

symbols.name: PluginRegistry
symbols.summary: The Versatia plugins running on the server, by the name the runtime registered them under: their `@FriendlyName`, or the `name:` of their `plugin.yml`.

symbols.name: ServiceNotRegisteredException
symbols.summary: Thrown by `VersatiaEngine.loadService` when no plugin provides the service.

symbols.name: StateKey
symbols.summary: Identifies one entry of a `StateStore`; the type parameter is the entry's type.

symbols.name: StateStore
symbols.summary: State shared between processors: an entry is created on first use and kept until the store is dropped, when entries implementing `AutoCloseable` are closed, last created first.

symbols.name: VersatiaAttribute
symbols.summary: Marks an annotation whose occurrences are recorded in the descriptor, with their arguments, next to the element they decorate: an enhanced class and its constructor parameters, an enhanced function and its parameters.

symbols.name: VersatiaDisabler
symbols.summary: Marks a `Boolean` parameter of an annotation as a switch: when the parameter is `true` on a plugin's main class or on one of its base classes, the enhancement annotation `enhancement` written on that class or on a class above it is left out of the descriptor.

symbols.name: VersatiaEngine

symbols.name: VersatiaEnhancement
symbols.signature: @VersatiaEnhancement(processorClass: String, enhancementPhase: Phase = Phase.UNSET, enhancementPhaseParamRefName: String = "")
symbols.summary: Marks an annotation as an enhancement: names the processor that interprets its occurrences and says when.

symbols.name: VersatiaInternalApi
symbols.summary: Marks the plumbing between the compile-time step, the generated descriptor and VersatiaCore: public only because those live in other modules.

symbols.name: VersatiaPlugin
symbols.summary: Base class of Versatia plugins.

symbols.name: VersatiaSubclassEnhancement
symbols.summary: Marks an annotation as an enhancement of every class in the plugin's sources that is assignable to `subclassOf`: each such class is recorded as if the annotation had been written on it.

symbols.name: broadcast
symbols.summary: Sends `message` to everyone holding `permission`, by default every player and the console; returns the number of recipients.

symbols.name: checkNotPrimaryThread

symbols.name: checkPrimaryThread

symbols.name: classLoader

symbols.name: dispatchConsoleCommand

symbols.name: AutoInvoke

symbols.name: ExtractResources
symbols.summary: Copies every file under the `DIRECTORY` directory of the plugin's JAR (`src/main/resources/resources/` in the build) into the plugin's data folder when the plugin starts and at every reload, keeping the directory layout.

symbols.name: BackgroundTask
symbols.summary: Work that runs as long as its plugin, found at compile time, never registered.

symbols.name: KeyedJobs

symbols.name: PlayerValues

symbols.name: PluginScope
symbols.summary: The coroutines of the plugin this is injected into, also as `CoroutineScope`: they run on the server thread, starting at once when launched from it, unless they switch with `withContext`; a reload leaves them alone, and the plugin's stop cancels them before its stop functions run.

symbols.name: RecheckTrigger
symbols.summary: A Bukkit event that makes a `Condition` evaluate its check again; built with `recheckOn`.

symbols.name: RunBackgroundTasks
symbols.summary: Runs every class of the plugin implementing `BackgroundTask` in the plugin's `PluginScope`: started at the tick after the plugin started, cancelled and started again by every reload once the values are set, and cancelled before the plugin's stop functions run, together with every other coroutine of the scope.

symbols.name: keyedJobs
